# moddotplot-rs v0.2.0-beta.3

**Note:** This file was generated by ChatGPT 5.6 Sol under the direction of Adam Phillippy.

This third 0.2 beta adds genome-browser-style feature tracks and strengthens local
input handling and plot layout. It remains a functional preview for scientific
evaluation, not a research-validated release. This release is tagged locally; nothing
is deployed, uploaded, or published by the release process.

## Highlights

* Sequence-derived GC% and CpG observed/expected tracks can be enabled independently
  on the X or Y axis, or together, with unsmoothed per-display-window bars and hover
  values.
* Plain-text or gzip-compressed BED3–12, GFF3, and GTF annotations can be imported by
  dropping them on an axis or using the sequence-aware **Add track** action.
* Imported tracks support UCSC feature colors, grouped transcript/exon/CDS/intron
  models, category-aware gene colors, feature mouseovers, and one-to-ten-row packing.
* Tracks follow their associated sequence, can be reordered directly in the track
  strip, and can be disabled by dragging them away from the strip.
* Sequence-derived tracks use overscanned caches for synchronized panning and clear
  immediately whenever their cached data becomes stale.
* FASTA loading now rejects annotation files before parsing and reports parse failures
  without publishing a partial workspace.
* Plot and track layout is more compact, the plot assembly centers in surplus space,
  and a depth-sorted rotating B-DNA canvas indicates active work in an empty plot.
* Heatmap sliders now move in 0.1 percentage-point increments, and the plot background
  uses adjacent White/Black controls.

## Scientific compatibility

The dotplot estimator, heatmap values, and default scientific configuration are
unchanged from v0.2.0-beta.2. The 256-register preview and 1,024-register detailed
configuration digests remain `58e084b7190f4d93` and `bc5c5131ad1c9a20`, respectively.
The beta.1 [validation record](v0.2.0-beta.1/VALIDATION.md) remains the numerical
evidence for those configurations.

GC% and CpG observed/expected are new display-only sequence summaries. Annotation
records are parsed and rendered locally and do not affect dotplot computation.

## Verification

* Rust formatting, strict Clippy checks, and the complete workspace test suite pass.
* All 31 TypeScript unit tests pass.
* The production Rust/Wasm and TypeScript/WebGL build passes.
* All 30 behavioral browser tests pass in Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit; the 10-test
  suite also passes in installed Google Chrome.
* Documentation-link and generated SBOM checks pass.

## Known limitations

* The release remains a functional preview, not research-validated software.
* BigWig, BigBed, VCF, and indexed remote annotation sources are not yet supported.
* Imported annotations and loaded sequences are session-local and are discarded on
  reload.
* Robust one-billion-base operation still requires sequence/sketch sharding and
  bounded disk spill.
* Approximate identity below roughly 80% remains outside the target operating regime.
* Numeric/high-resolution image export and stable numeric/pixel goldens remain open
  work.
* Static files require HTTP or HTTPS; direct `file://` execution is unsupported.
